add.title: Add file share
add.description: Connect an SMB share or an NFS export. The connection is tested before it is saved; the password is stored encrypted.

smb.title: SMB (Windows, Samba, NAS)
smb.description: A share of a Windows server, Samba or a NAS, with an account that may read it and its permissions.

nfs.title: NFS
nfs.description: An export of a Linux server or NAS. The export must allow this server's address and root access (no_root_squash) to read everything.

hints.server: Host name or IP address, without \\ or smb://.
hints.share: The share name, for example Projects.
hints.subfolder: Optional: back up only this folder of the share.
hints.account: For example backup or DOMAIN\backup. Read access to all files is enough.
hints.domain: Optional; can also be written before the account.
hints.seal: SMB 3 encryption. Needed when the server requires it.
hints.name: Shown in the list, in jobs and in alerts.
hints.permissions: Stores the NTFS or NFS permissions of every file and folder, so a restore puts them back.
hints.allowRestore: Off by default. On, restores and copies may write into this share.

errors.serverNoProtocol: Enter the server without \\ or a protocol such as smb://.

errors.passwordTooLong: The password can have at most 256 bytes.
